title: Cohomology sheaves and acyclic complexes of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and $\mathcal F^\bullet$ a cochain complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For $i\in\mathbf Z$ the $i$-th *cohomology sheaf* of $\mathcal F^\bullet$ is the $\mathcal O$-module $H^i(\mathcal F^\bullet)=\Ker(d^i)/\Im(d^{i-1})$, the quotient taken in the abelian category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; a morphism of complexes $f$ induces morphisms $H^i(f)$, functorially. The complex $\mathcal F^\bullet$ is *acyclic* if $H^i(\mathcal F^\bullet)=0$ for all $i\in\mathbf Z$, equivalently if the sequence $\mathcal F^{i-1}\to\mathcal F^i\to\mathcal F^{i+1}$ is exact in $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ for every $i$.
